name: Insurance
headline: Where protection meets perfection.
details: Auto, motorcycle and personal cover from top carriers. We compare quotes side by side, explain every line in plain English or Bangla, and keep your policy current when life changes.

name: TLC Insurance
headline: Your cab earns. We keep it covered.
details: Liability and physical damage cover built for yellow cabs, green cabs and black cars. We file straight with the TLC so your plates never sit idle.

name: TLC Express
headline: Moving plates? We do the paperwork.
details: New car, plate transfer or base change: we prepare and file the TLC paperwork, book your inspection and follow it through to the finish.

name: DMV Express
headline: Came in for plates. Left with plates.
details: Registrations, renewals, plates and title transfers without the DMV line. Bring your papers, we handle the rest and hand you the plates.

name: Tax
headline: Tax season, made easy.
details: Personal, self-employed and rideshare returns, plus IRS and New York letters. Federal and state filed together, every credit checked.

name: Travel
headline: Book the flight. We handle the rest.
details: Flights home and holidays abroad, booked at fair fares. We check passports and visas before you pay, so nothing stops you at the gate.

name: Courses
headline: Learn the rules. Own the road.
details: 5-hour pre-licensing and defensive driving courses in English and Bangla. Pass the road test, take points off and cut your insurance.

name: Notary
headline: Sign it. Seal it. Done.
details: Affidavits, leases, titles and letters signed and sealed while you wait. Walk in with ID, walk out notarized.

name: Business Insurance
headline: You run the shop. We cover the shop.
details: General liability, property and commercial auto for shops, restaurants and contractors, with certificates for landlords and clients the same day.

name: Rideshare
headline: You drive the app. We cover the gap.
details: Uber and Lyft drivers: your personal policy stops when the app turns on. We add the rideshare cover that fills the gap.

name: Home & Landlord
headline: Your home. Your rental. Covered.
details: Homeowners, condo and landlord policies for one- to four-family homes. Cover the building, the rent and the people who live there.

name: Life & Disability
headline: For the people who count on you.
details: Term and whole life, plus disability income cover that pays your bills if you can't work. Simple plans for the people who count on you.

name: Workers’ Comp
headline: Protect your crew. Protect your business.
details: New York requires it once you hire. We set up workers' comp and disability (DBL/PFL) cover and keep your certificates current.

name: Business Setup
headline: Got the idea? Let’s make it official.
details: LLC and corporation formation, EIN, sales tax registration and a business bank-ready file. Your idea, made official.

name: Payroll & Sales Tax
headline: Pay your team. Skip the headache.
details: Weekly or bi-weekly payroll, W-2s and 1099s, plus New York sales tax returns filed on time, every quarter.

name: Immigration Forms
headline: The right forms, filled out with care.
details: Citizenship, green card renewal, family petitions and work permits: the right USCIS forms, filled out with care. We prepare forms; we do not give legal advice.
